title: Ask to be kept by the Will
summary: The self-willed mind wastes itself in attachment, while Nanak asks to be kept by the Lord's pleasure. Peace begins when pride becomes prayer.
takeaway: Ask to be kept before pride decides how to survive.
lifeApplication: When defensiveness hardens, do not make the next move from that heat. Pause long enough to ask, 'Keep me as You please,' then choose the humbler action.
